requests.required_behavior: Provide a source-verified Moradon terrain + shape height resolver usable by NPC placement and compatible terrain validation without guessed Y values.
requests.current_behavior: WS16 has the resolver port and policy but K_NPCPOS contains no Y; WS15 and WS25 also fail closed where terrain/height ownership is required.
requests.acceptance_test: Moradon NPC population resolves source-backed X/Z through the real height authority and produces deterministic finite Y while unresolved/missing terrain still fails closed.
requests.milestone_impact: Blocks canonical acceptance of MORADON NPC/MOB VISIBILITY even though registry/discovery tooling can operate.
